release_read.basis: Adjusted EPS C$0.33 against a C$0.27 consensus (about +22%) and the FY27 adjusted EPS guide raised to C$1.28-1.35 from C$1.21-1.28, with the margin guide also raised, which kills the hunt's guide-cut leg. Offsets: revenue C$1,204.7M about 4% below the C$1.256B bar, civil margin down to 15.9% from 18.5%, civil book-to-bill 0.89x, and C$11M of prior-year defense tax credits in the beat, all after a +16.6% run-up.

release.headline: CAE reports second quarter fiscal 2027 results

vs_bar.consensus_source: brief eps_forecast_nasdaq (Nasdaq fallback); actual is reported in CAD only, not converted

key_line.metric: FY27 guide and civil margin (Middle East drag)
key_line.detail: Guide raised: adjusted EPS C$1.28-1.35 (was 1.21-1.28), adjusted segment operating margin 14.9-15.4% (was 14.6-15.1%), revenue low-single-digit growth unchanged. The raise is attributed to operating performance, lower finance expense and a lower tax rate. Civil margin 15.9% vs 18.5%; civil book-to-bill 0.89x; Middle East mitigations 'effective so far', with intensification flagged as a risk. Defense margin 13.6% vs 9.3% includes C$11M prior-year investment tax credits. Adjusted measures exclude acquisition-intangible amortization since Q1 FY27 (about C$0.05/share in Q2, prior year restated 0.23 -> 0.28); whether every consensus source is on that basis is not confirmed, so the true beat may be smaller than 22%.

guidance.detail: FY27 adjusted EPS C$1.28-1.35 from C$1.21-1.28; FY consensus sat at the bottom of the old range (about C$1.21 per the hunt), so the new low end is above the street. Buybacks continued: 1.9M shares for C$67.1M in Q2. No dividend announced in the part of the release read.

call.detail: Call scheduled 08:00 ET today, before the open, so it should be over by the open; no transcript or call takeaways found in time. No number from the call is used.

tape_read.note: Robust pre-market reference 28.175 is +2.87% on the 27.39 close (after hours +0.69%), against a release read of +4.0% and a rebuilt historical median reaction of about 5.25% (no option-implied move). Only 4 prints, last at 08:58, stale_at_open true, while SPY is -0.7% and QQQ -1.4% pre-market. The short is losing about 3.8% against the 27.11 entry. CAE's TSX line opens at the same 09:30, so there is no home-market price to lean on.

thesis_check.note: The short rested on a guide cut from the Gulf drag and a +17% EPS bar; the guide was raised and adjusted EPS beat. Only the revenue miss and the weak civil margin and orders support it, and the reaction history (0 of 6 up, the Nov 2025 after-hours pop faded to flat) is the only reason to expect a fade.

expected.open_lag_note: amc with a night to read it, but the pre-market is thin and stale (4 prints, last 08:58), so the open is less reliable than usual; a clear guide raise and a pre-market below my release read argue against a lag and against a fade, while a weak tape (QQQ -1.4%) and this name's habit of fading after-hours pops argue for one, so the fade is a coin flip.

recommendation.reason: De cijfers spreken de short tegen: hogere winst dan verwacht en een verhoogde jaarverwachting, terwijl de koers voorbeurs (+2,9%) nog minder is gestegen dan de cijfers rechtvaardigen. Er is geen goede reden om langer tegen deze stijging in te blijven zitten; dek de short bij de opening, gelijk aan de standaardregel.
recommendation.what_would_change_it: Als de voorbeurskoers voor 09:30 terugzakt naar het slot van gisteren (rond 27,4) of als er negatieve signalen uit de call van 08:00 komen, kan wachten tot 10:00 beter zijn.
